resources.string: Choose visible text with 🔊 and hear it through your TTS server.

Tapping 🔊 reads visible read-only text to outline choices. Only the block you then tap is sent to your configured text-to-speech server. Text and generated audio stay in memory on the phone; the server has its own retention policy. Stop, leaving the app, or locking the phone cancels reading. Password fields are excluded.

Tap 🔊 on the floating control, then tap an outlined text block. Tap 🔊 again to stop. Drag either icon to move the controls. 🎤 keeps dictation and selected voice-note captions. Volume-down still dictates. English is ready to configure; Hebrew and Russian need their own supported voices.
Use the base URL ending in /v1, without /audio/speech. Hebrew/Russian may leave it empty to use the English/default endpoint.
Use a voice your server supports. An empty Hebrew/Russian voice refuses reading in that language.
Explicitly send that TTS token to this language endpoint. Otherwise it uses only its own token.
Use a timeout from 1 to 120 seconds.
Dictate or caption the selected voice note
Choose text to read aloud, or stop reading
Enable Read aloud in Voxdroid settings first.
Finish the current dictation, voice caption or call first.
No visible read-only text block found. Choose text of at least 15 characters.
Tap an outlined text block. Tap elsewhere to cancel.
Read aloud failed. Check the TTS server, network and Tailscale.
